docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS OEX CALENDAR OF JAN-06-2022 IS CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF PLAINTIFF TO JAN-13-2022 AT 11:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. ARTURO SANDOVAL, ESQ. APPEARING FOR AND WITH RASHEL MOREIN, JUDGEMENT CREDITOR. JUDGEMENT DEBTOR ISMAEL LOPEZ IS PRESENT, ASSISTED BY CERTIFIED COURT INTERPRETER DANIEL NAVARRO. JUDGMENT DEBTOR DID NOT BRING ALL HIS ACCOUNT(S)INFORMATION, AND JUDGMENT CREDITOR REQUESTED TO BE HEARD BEFORE THE JUDGE REGARDING THE DEMANDS OF THE ISSUED SUBPOENA: TAX RETURNS. THE PLAINTIFF WAS ADVISED TO BRING HIS BANK ACCOUNT STATEMENTS FROM 2019 THROUGH 2021, 2019 AND 2021 TAX RETURNS AND HIS CAR TITLE IN RESPONSE TO THE SUBPOENA. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: A. DATT. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
ORDER OF EXAMINATION HEARING CONTINUED FOR ADDITIONAL EVIDENCE FROM THE JUDGMENT DEBTOR. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT).
ORDER TO DISCHARGE OEX HEARING. PLAINTIFF GOT ASSET INFORMATION AND A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT.

THE ORDER OF EXAMINATION IS DISCHARGED AS TO DEFENDANT, ALL PARTIES WERE PRESENT. ARTRUO SANDOVAL, ESQ. APPEARING FOR AND WITH PLAINTIFF/JUDGMENT CREDITOR RASHEL MOREIN. DEFENDANT ISMEAL LOPEZ IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED SPANISH INTERPRETER PATRICE BINAISA. HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG TAKES THE BENCH AND DETERMINES THAT ALL OF THE SUBPOENAED DOCUMENTS HAVE BEEN PRODUCED WHICH SATISFIES THE SUBPOENA'S REQUESTS.PARTIES CAME TO A SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT IN COURT FOR PAYMENTS OF $300 A MONTH TO THE PLAINTIFF, FOR A TOTAL AMOUNT OF $8575. THE FIRST PAYMENT SHALL START ON FEB-1ST AND TO BE PAID ON FIRST OF EVERY MONTH THEREAFTER FOR 28 MONTHS, THE 29TH PAYMENT WILL BE FOR $175. THE JUDGMENT DEBTOR IS TO GO TO BANK OF AMERICA TO MAKE A DEPOSIT OF 300 A MONTH TO RACHEL AND DAN MORIEN'S CHECKING ACCOUNT AND TO NOTE THE BALANCE ON EACH CHECK DEPOSITED. AS LONG AS PAYMENTS ARE BEING MADE THE JUDGMENT CREDITOR SHALL NOT FILE A MEMO OF COSTS. IN THE EVENT THAT MS. MORIEN PASSES THE PAYMENTS WILL BE PAID TO THE SAME BANK OF AMERICA ACCOUNT ADDRESSED TO DAN MORIEN, HER SON. JUDGMENT CREDITOR IS ALLOWED A PHOTOCOPY OF THE VEHICLE TITLE AND THE BANK STATEMENT IN CASE THE AGREEMENT FALLS APART. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)

JUDGEMENT DEBTOR ISMAEL LOPEZ IS PRESENT, ASSISTED BY CERTIFIED COURT INTERPRETER MONICA HERNANDEZ. JUDGMENT DEBTOR DID NOT BRING HIS ACCOUNT(S) INFORMATION, AND JUDGMENT CREDITOR REQUESTED TO BE HEARD BEFORE THE JUDGE REGARDING THE DEMANDS OF THE ISSUED SUBPOENA: TAX RETURNS.
